labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Advisory concerns the pygments dependency, not Rich code

body:
This report concerns an advisory about the pygments dependency, not a defect in Rich itself. An earlier report of the same advisory is #4044, which is already closed. Dependency version changes are tracked separately from this issue.

For private vulnerability reports, see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
